_about: Curated REAL facts (static, not live) from the Canadian Space Agency 'Food production' toolkit. Only cited facts/figures; no copied images. Edit by hand if the pages change.

source.institution: Canadian Space Agency (CSA) — Government of Canada
source.product: Toolkit for educators and youth — Food production

crops.note: Approximate growth time in days (CSA activity 'Interplanetary Farming')

crewDiet.note: ISS menus contain between 1900 and 3200 calories per day, depending on each crewmember

plantHabitat.note: Advanced Plant Habitat (ISS) regulates temperature, oxygen and CO2; Veggie uses 'plant pillows' with clay, fertilizer and seeds

plantsLifeSupport.note: Plants can provide food, produce oxygen, and recycle carbon dioxide and some organic waste (Tomatosphere)
